```{r setup, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# Shared paths, packages, and helper functions

```

```{r}
catchments <- st_read(catchment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

catchments_centroid <- st_centroid(catchments)

catchment_lat <- catchments_centroid %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(lon = X, lat = Y) %>%
  mutate(comid = catchments$comid) %>%
  select(comid, lon, lat)

# Keep this small lookup table in memory.
head(catchment_lat)
```

```{r}
drivers_in_file <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily_joined.parquet")
drivers_pet_out_file <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily.parquet")

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")

# Give DuckDB access to the small latitude lookup table.
dbWriteTable(con, "catchment_lat", catchment_lat, overwrite = TRUE)

# Join and compute PET inside DuckDB instead of R memory.
dbExecute(con, paste0("
COPY (
  SELECT
    d.*,
    cl.lon,
    cl.lat,

    -- Day of year
    CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) AS DOY,

    -- Extraterrestrial radiation, Ra, in mm/day
    (
      (
        (24 * 60 / pi()) * 0.0820 *
        (1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER))) *
        (
          acos(
            -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
          ) *
          sin(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
          sin(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
          +
          cos(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
          cos(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39)) *
          sin(
            acos(
              -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
              tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            )
          )
        )
      ) * 0.408
    ) AS Ra,

    -- Catchment-scale Hargreaves PET
    0.0023 * (d.tmean_c + 17.8) *
      sqrt(greatest(d.tmax_c - d.tmin_c, 0)) *
      (
        (
          (24 * 60 / pi()) * 0.0820 *
          (1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER))) *
          (
            acos(
              -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
              tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            ) *
            sin(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            sin(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            +
            cos(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            cos(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39)) *
            sin(
              acos(
                -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
                tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
              )
            )
          )
        ) * 0.408
      ) AS PET,

    -- Basin-scale Hargreaves PET
    0.0023 * (d.bsn_tmean_c + 17.8) *
      sqrt(greatest(d.bsn_tmax_c - d.bsn_tmin_c, 0)) *
      (
        (
          (24 * 60 / pi()) * 0.0820 *
          (1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER))) *
          (
            acos(
              -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
              tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            ) *
            sin(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            sin(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            +
            cos(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            cos(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39)) *
            sin(
              acos(
                -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
                tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
              )
            )
          )
        ) * 0.408
      ) AS bsn_PET,

    sin(2 * pi() * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) / 365) AS DOY_sin,
    cos(2 * pi() * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) / 365) AS DOY_cos

  FROM read_parquet('", drivers_in_file, "') d
  LEFT JOIN catchment_lat cl
  ON CAST(d.comid AS VARCHAR) = CAST(cl.comid AS VARCHAR)
)
TO '", drivers_pet_out_file, "'
(FORMAT PARQUET);
"))

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

cat("Saved PET-enhanced daily drivers to:", drivers_pet_out_file, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Sanity check to make sure calculations were made 

drivers_pet <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily.parquet"))

drivers_pet %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_comids = n_distinct(comid),
    pct_Ra = mean(!is.na(Ra)),
    pct_PET = mean(!is.na(PET)),
    pct_bsn_tmean_c = mean(!is.na(bsn_tmean_c)),
    pct_bsn_PET = mean(!is.na(bsn_PET)),
    pct_bsn_temp_and_Ra = mean(
      !is.na(bsn_tmax_c) &
      !is.na(bsn_tmin_c) &
      !is.na(bsn_tmean_c) &
      !is.na(Ra)
    )
  )
```
